profile.registerNotes: Use você with the candidate, or o senhor/a senhora in formal role-plays (official, older person). Brazilian Portuguese.

2: a current event in your country
2+: advantages and disadvantages of a policy
a problem in your community and its causes
3: supporting an opinion on an abstract issue
hypothetical: what if your country changed a major policy
the role of technology in society

rolePlaySeeds: Check into a hotel and solve a problem with the reservation (interviewer: receptionist).
Buy a train ticket after the train you wanted was cancelled (interviewer: ticket agent).
Report a lost passport at a police station (interviewer: police officer).
Arrange a meeting time with a colleague whose schedule keeps changing (interviewer: colleague).
Persuade a landlord to fix a broken heater before winter (interviewer: landlord).
Brief a local official about a joint exercise that will close a road (interviewer: town official).
Explain a misunderstanding between two delegations as their interpreter (interviewer: delegation leader).
At a checkpoint, explain why your convoy must pass before noon (interviewer: checkpoint officer).

rolePlays.situation: You are at a bus station and need to buy a ticket to São Paulo. The bus you wanted is full, and you need to take an earlier one.
rolePlays.opening: Bom dia! Em que posso ajudar você hoje?
rolePlays.english: Good morning! How can I help you today?

rolePlays.situation: You are at a restaurant and would like to order food, but you are unsure what dishes are available.
rolePlays.opening: Olá, o que você gostaria de pedir hoje?
rolePlays.english: Hello, what would you like to order today?

rolePlays.situation: You are at a hospital and need to see a doctor. The receptionist informs you that the doctor is busy and you will have to wait.
rolePlays.opening: Bom dia! Como posso te ajudar?
rolePlays.english: Good morning! How can I help you?

rolePlays.situation: You are at a store and want to buy a gift for a friend. You are not sure what to get and need advice.
rolePlays.opening: Boa tarde! Em que posso te ajudar a encontrar hoje?
rolePlays.english: Good afternoon! How can I help you find something today?

rolePlays.situation: You are at a hotel and need to check in, but the hotel is overbooked and they don't have your reservation.
rolePlays.opening: Bom dia! Como posso te ajudar?
rolePlays.english: Good morning! How can I help you?

rolePlays.situation: You need to buy a train ticket to Rio de Janeiro, but the train you wanted is cancelled and you need to find an alternative.
rolePlays.opening: Olá! Como posso te ajudar hoje?
rolePlays.english: Hello! How can I help you today?

rolePlays.situation: You lost your passport and need to report it to the police. The police officer is busy and you need to wait.
rolePlays.opening: Bom dia! Qual é o problema?
rolePlays.english: Good morning! What's the problem?

rolePlays.situation: You need to arrange a meeting time with a colleague, but their schedule keeps changing. You need to find a suitable time for both of you.
rolePlays.opening: Oi! Você queria marcar uma reunião, certo?
rolePlays.english: Hi! You wanted to schedule a meeting, right?

rolePlays.situation: You are at a hotel and need to check in, but there is a problem with your reservation.
rolePlays.opening: Bom dia! Como posso te ajudar hoje?
rolePlays.english: Good morning! How can I help you today?

rolePlays.situation: You need to buy a train ticket to Rio de Janeiro for tomorrow, but the train you wanted is cancelled and you need to find an alternative.
rolePlays.opening: Bom dia! Em que posso ajudar?
rolePlays.english: Good morning! How can I assist you?

rolePlays.situation: You lost your passport and need to report it to the police. The police officer is busy and you need to wait.
rolePlays.opening: Bom dia! Como posso ajudar? Por favor, sente-se um momento.
rolePlays.english: Good morning! How can I help? Please have a seat for a moment.

rolePlays.situation: You are a liaison officer and need to brief a local official about a joint exercise that will close a road for a few hours.
rolePlays.opening: Bom dia! Em que posso ajudar hoje?
rolePlays.english: Good morning! How can I assist you today?

rolePlays.situation: You are at a checkpoint and need to explain why your convoy must pass before noon. The checkpoint officer is skeptical and needs convincing.
rolePlays.opening: Bom dia! Posso ver sua identificação e os documentos do seu convoi, por favor?
rolePlays.english: Good morning! May I see your identification and the documents for your convoy, please?

rolePlays.situation: You are a military interpreter and need to explain a misunderstanding between two delegations. The delegation leader is frustrated and needs reassurance.
rolePlays.opening: O que está acontecendo aqui? Parece que há um grande mal-entendido entre nossas delegações.
rolePlays.english: What is happening here? It seems there is a big misunderstanding between our delegations.

rolePlays.situation: You are at a restaurant and want to order food, but you are not sure what dishes are available. The waiter is busy and you need to ask for their help.
rolePlays.opening: Bom dia! Qual é a sua sugestão para o almoço de hoje?
rolePlays.english: Good afternoon! What is your suggestion for lunch today?

rolePlays.situation: You are at a hotel and need to check in, but the hotel is overbooked and they don't have your reservation. The receptionist is apologetic and needs to find a solution.
rolePlays.opening: Bom dia! Como posso te ajudar hoje?
rolePlays.english: Good morning! How can I help you today?

rolePlays.situation: You are a military interpreter and need to explain a misunderstanding between two delegations. The delegation leader is frustrated and needs reassurance.
rolePlays.opening: Olhe, estou muito frustrado com essa situação. Parece que há um mal-entendido entre nossas delegações e precisamos resolver isso imediatamente.
rolePlays.english: Look, I am very frustrated with this situation. It seems there is a misunderstanding between our delegations and we need to resolve this immediately.

rolePlays.situation: You are at a checkpoint and need to explain why your convoy must pass before noon. The checkpoint officer is skeptical and needs convincing.
rolePlays.opening: Bom dia, senhor. Meu convoy precisa passar por este checkpoint antes do meio-dia. Entendo que possa parecer estranho, mas há uma razão importante para isso.
rolePlays.english: Good morning, sir. My convoy needs to pass through this checkpoint before noon. I understand that it may seem strange, but there is an important reason for this.

rolePlays.situation: You are a liaison officer and need to brief a local official about a joint exercise that will close a road for a few hours. The official is concerned about the impact on local traffic.
rolePlays.opening: Bom dia, senhor. Gostaria de informá-lo sobre um exercício conjunto que ocorrerá amanhã. Infelizmente, precisaremos fechar uma estrada local por algumas horas.
rolePlays.english: Good morning, sir. I would like to inform you about a joint exercise that will take place tomorrow. Unfortunately, we will need to close a local road for a few hours.

rolePlays.situation: You are at a restaurant and want to order food, but you are not sure what dishes are available. The waiter is busy and you need to ask for their help.
rolePlays.opening: Com licença, você poderia me ajudar um momento? Estou tentando decidir o que pedir, mas não estou familiarizado com alguns pratos.
rolePlays.english: Excuse me, could you help me for a moment? I'm trying to decide what to order, but I'm not familiar with some of the dishes.

rolePlays.situation: You are a liaison officer and need to brief a local official about a joint exercise that will close a road for a few hours. The official is concerned about the impact on local traffic. The official is also worried about noise disturbances during the night.
rolePlays.opening: Bom dia! Recebi sua mensagem sobre o exercício conjunto. No entanto, tenho algumas preocupações. Como vamos manejar o tráfego local durante esse período?
rolePlays.english: Good morning! I received your message about the joint exercise. However, I have some concerns. How will we handle local traffic during this period?

rolePlays.situation: You are a military interpreter and need to explain a misunderstanding between two delegations. The delegation leader is frustrated and needs reassurance. The other delegation has accused your side of not respecting the agreed schedule.
rolePlays.opening: O que está acontecendo? A outra delegação está insatisfeita e diz que não estamos respeitando o cronograma combinado. Precisamos resolver isso imediatamente.
rolePlays.english: What's going on? The other delegation is unhappy and says that we are not respecting the agreed schedule. We need to resolve this immediately.

rolePlays.situation: You are at a restaurant and want to order food, but you are not sure what dishes are available. The waiter is busy and you need to ask for their help. The restaurant has recently changed its menu and the waiter is not very familiar with the new dishes.
rolePlays.opening: Bom dia! Aqui está o cardápio. Tenho que avisar que estamos com um novo menu e ainda não conheço todos os pratos. Como posso ajudá-lo(a)?
rolePlays.english: Good morning! Here is the menu. I have to warn you that we have a new menu and I am not yet familiar with all the dishes. How can I help you?

rolePlays.situation: You are at a hotel and need to check in, but the hotel is overbooked and they don't have your reservation. The receptionist is apologetic and needs to find a solution. The hotel's sister property down the street has vacancies and offers to arrange transportation.
rolePlays.opening: Bom dia! Lamentamos informar que estávamos com sobrevenda e não temos sua reserva. No entanto, nosso hotel irmão na rua abaixo tem disponibilidade. Posso arrumar um transporte para você?
rolePlays.english: Good morning! We apologize to inform you that we were overbooked and do not have your reservation. However, our sister hotel down the street has availability. Can I arrange transportation for you?

topics.opener: Você pode descrever o treinamento tático que a unidade está realizando no momento?

0+: I can greet people and say my name.
I can give numbers, prices, days and times.
I can answer very simple questions with memorized phrases.
1: I can make simple sentences about myself, my family and my daily routine.
I can ask and answer simple questions about familiar topics.
I can handle basic needs: ordering food, buying a ticket, asking for directions.
1+: I can describe places and people in connected sentences.
I can tell what happened on a recent trip or weekend.
I can handle routine situations even when something small goes wrong.
2: I can narrate past, present and future events in paragraphs.
I can describe and explain concrete topics at work and in the news.
I can resolve a complication in a role-play, like a cancelled reservation.
2+: I can often support my opinions with reasons and examples.
I can discuss some abstract topics, although I sometimes break down.
I can explain the causes and effects of a problem in my community.
3: I can support and defend opinions on abstract and unfamiliar topics.
I can hypothesize about situations that did not happen.
I can speak at length with good control of grammar and vocabulary.
